## How it was checked

- [ ] A test that fails without this change (for a fix: it reproduces the bug)
- [ ] `pytest tests plan/acceptance` passes, and `cd web && npm run build` if the observer changed
- [ ] For a change to what chits do: an A/B over many seeds (say the seeds, days and results below)
- [ ] No secrets, personal paths, hostnames or IP addresses in the diff, logs or screenshots
